data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 市集里的围巾试色
data.description: 市集布摊前，拉芙塔莉雅穿青绿长衫和米白马甲，将一条赭色围巾比在肩上。她低头看布料，再伸手摸摸毛绒耳边的边线，认真挑选不会扎人的织法，尾巴安静垂在身后。
data.action: 把围巾比在肩上，摸摸织边是否柔软。
data.promptProse: At the market fabric stall, Raphtalia holds an ochre scarf against her teal tunic and cream waistcoat, then feels its edge beside a furry ear to check the weave. Her tail hangs quietly behind brown trousers and lace-up boots. The medium portrait includes folded bolts along the counter. Daylight diffused by the awning reveals scarf fibers and her thoughtful face, with soft shadows between the fabric rolls and beneath her hand.
